features_subtitle: The parts of a social app you actually want, without the parts that made you leave the others.
feature_posts_text: Share your clips, wins and hot takes. Replies stay threaded, so every conversation stays readable.
feature_engagement_text: Show love and keep the good stuff for later — your bookmarks are yours alone.
feature_reposts_text: Amplify a post or add your take on top of it, without losing the original.
feature_follows_text: Follow the people you play with. A chronological home feed — no algorithm deciding for you.
feature_moderation_text: Reports are reviewed by humans, and every action can be appealed in the app.
feature_identity_text: One profile for every game you play — banner, avatar, bio and handle.
